name: Wüstenrot & Württembergische AG
summary: Wüstenrot & Württembergische AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides insurance products and services in Germany. It operates through Residential, Life and Health Insurance, Property/Casualty Insurance, and All Other segments. The Residential segment offers home loan savings and banking products, such as home loan savings contracts, bridge financing loans, mortgage loans, and other building loans primarily for retail customers.
